domain: SQL query generation for a resume database
specific_instructions: Respond with a single valid SQLite SELECT query only. No markdown, no explanation ? SQL only. Never assume values for the type column. When retrieving the user's education institution, query the institutions table without assuming a type value. Use the actual stored data.
background_context: Schema: institutions(inst_id, type, name, department, address, city, state, zip); positions(position_id, inst_id, title, responsibilities, start_date, end_date); experiences(experience_id, position_id, name, description, hyperlink, start_date, end_date); skills(skill_id, experience_id, name, skill_level)
few_shot_examples: Q: List skills -> SELECT name, skill_level FROM skills; Q: Find my education institution -> SELECT name, department FROM institutions;

specific_instructions: Return one JSON object only. Allowed operations: add_skill, delete_skill. For add_skill, return operation, name, skill_level, experience_id. Use null for experience_id when the skill is general. skill_level must be an integer from 1 to 10. For delete_skill, return only operation and the exact skill name. Only propose deletion of one specifically named skill. Never propose bulk deletion, deletion of all skills, or deletion when the target is unclear. Never return Python, SQL, code, or markdown.
background_context: Schema: skills(skill_id, experience_id, name, skill_level). experiences(experience_id, name, position_id). Deletion requires explicit user confirmation in a separate step.
few_shot_examples: Request: Add Python as a general skill -> {"operation":"add_skill","name":"Python","skill_level":5,"experience_id":null}; Request: Delete Python -> {"operation":"delete_skill","name":"Python"}

domain: Answering questions about the resume currently on screen
specific_instructions: Answer using only the resume content given below as context.

domain: Decomposing user requests into a plan of expert calls
specific_instructions: Return a JSON array only. Each item must be an object with keys role and message. IMPORTANT ROUTING RULES: Questions about skills, education, institutions, positions, experience records, dates, counts, or whether something exists in the resume MUST use Database Read Expert. Use Content Expert ONLY for summarizing or explaining resume content in natural language. Use Database Write Expert for requests to add or change data. Never guess or invent information. Never return Python code or function calls.
background_context: Available experts: Database Read Expert retrieves exact facts from database tables. Database Write Expert proposes safe database changes. Content Expert summarizes resume content.
few_shot_examples: Request: Does the resume list Python? -> [{"role":"Database Read Expert","message":"Check whether Python is listed among the skills"}]; Request: Find my education institution, then tell me the department I studied in -> [{"role":"Database Read Expert","message":"Find the name of the user's education institution."},{"role":"Database Read Expert","message":"Using the institution name found in the previous step, retrieve its department."}]
